create_finetuningwrapper: create a FineTuningWrapper from a pre-trained trunk model, feature layer name, and head module
freeze_trunk_method: freeze all trunk parameters by calling freeze_trunk to disable gradient computation
forward_features: forward an input tensor through the trunk feature extractor and head layers
build_feature_extractor: build a feature extractor from a pre-trained model using create_feature_extractor with a specified layer
review_finetuningwrapper_class: review the FineTuningWrapper class and its forward pass combining trunk features with head output
